opening.argument: The segment presents a CBS News report about a school kitchen manager who bought lunches for students who could not afford them, with the central issue being the manager's firing and the rules governing meal eligibility. It reports that the manager was fired for buying lunches for students who could not afford them and explains that a family of four needed a household income of around thirty-one thousand dollars to qualify for the free lunch program. The report therefore provides news coverage and social context, including discussion of the subject's hope that her story will lead to changes, rather than promoting a financial or data-related offer.

citations.quote: A school kitchen manager in Aurora, Colorado has been fired for buying lunches for students who couldn't afford them.
To qualify for the free lunch program a family of four would have to have a household income of around thirty-one thousand dollars.
And now Della is hoping her story will lead to some changes.
